submission.project_name: CIVIS AI - Smart Urban Exploration & Safety Co-Pilot
submission.target_region: India Smart Metropolises (Pune, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Delhi)
submission.verified_by: Autonomous AI Studio Hackathon Jury Evaluation Suite

problem_statement_and_indian_relevance.notes: 100% localized to Indian cities. Directly solves pedestrian safety in unlit alleys and accident choke points (Silk Board, Dadar TT, FC Road) rather than foreign presets.

technical_execution_and_multi_service_ar.notes: Seamlessly integrates Google Gemini 2.5 Flash with strict JSON schema, CARTO Spatial MCP Server (ac_7l2l64mp), OpenStreetMap Nominatim reverse geocoding, and real browser Geolocation API.

innovation_and_civic_action.notes: AI Chatbot equipped with automatic municipal ticket escalation (e.g. CIVIS-TKT-PUN-8102) for unlit streets and potholes with validated contact formats.

ui_ux_design_and_visual_proof.notes: Features interactive Before/After route proof slider, Google Now ambient cards, 4D temporal slider, AR explorer mockup, and tactical dark mode with WCAG AA compliance.

security_performance_and_legal_governanc.notes: Zero frontend secrets, HTTPS enforcement, DPDP Act 2023 Privacy Policy, Terms, Cookie Consent Banner, client-side analytics, custom 404 page, and live Core Web Vitals speed audit.
